title: 2008 Financial Crisis
description: Collapse of the global banking system caused by subprime mortgage-backed securities, extreme institutional leverage, and systemic credit default swap default bands.

title: Dot-Com Bubble
description: Massive speculative technology bubble burst where high valuations of internet startups led to extensive equity liquidation.

title: Volcker Shock
description: Federal Reserve Chairman Paul Volcker raised the Fed Funds rate to 20% to break double-digit consumer price hyperinflation.

title: Black Wednesday
description: George Soros broke the Bank of England's Sterling peg to the European Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM) via massive leveraged short selling.

title: Nixon Shock
description: President Richard Nixon unilaterally closed the gold window, ending direct unilateral dollar-to-gold convertibility and breaking the Bretton Woods system.
